verdict.rationale: incident.io's own docs cover all three parts of the story. Suggestions uses AI to draft updates and summaries from live incident activity, suggested summaries target responders who lack time to communicate, and Scribe transcribes incident calls. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what Scribe actually produces as call notes (evidence is only a troubleshooting-page mention), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the live AI writing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI writes the incident as it happens — live summaries, drafted updates, and scribed call notes — so responders respond instead of typing

citations.quote: Suggestions uses AI to help teams communicate better during incidents by automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions based on your incident activity.
responders don’t always have time to digest lots of information or communicate externally what’s going on... This is where suggested summaries comes in.
errors that you might see when using incident.io to manage your incident calls, or when using Scribe to transcribe your incident calls.
